title: Feast or Famine
overview: A documentary following the London restaurant Angelina, its chefs and owners, over the span of three months, as they strive to achieve their ultimate goal of winning their first Michelin star.

title: The Last Solution
overview: Within the confines of a massive wall, a group of children plays as if there were no tomorrow

title: To Wander the Earth
overview: Across three pivotal moments in his life, a masochistic ex-Catholic desperately chases penitential fire, struggling to survive his loss of faith.

title: Fanatic
overview: What happens when a hero blindly pursues his goal, consumed by brutal rivalry? This is a ruthless play on fantasy conventions, where an existential crisis of masculinity proves more dangerous than dungeon monsters. A story of people so deeply attached to their roles that they fail to notice the coming end of the world.

title: Jesterpus - A Musical Comedy of Horrors
overview: Merlin awakens from his hibernation within a mountain when a prophecy is suddenly fulfilled: Jesterpus - a supernatural clown, previously defeated by Merlin and King Arthur - is released from his banishment on Mars, from where he was imprisoned 1400 years earlier.

title: Hope
overview: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

title: The Brave Swing
overview: These days, Cheng-Cheng seems different. He doesn’t play baseball anymore and stays away from the field. It feels like he has something he can’t tell anyone. His mom tries to help but doesn’t know why. The fear and confusion come from one of the adults he trusts the most. One evening, Cheng-Cheng stands by the field, holding his bat, wondering—should he swing, or not?

title: The Alice Paradox
overview: Alice travels through a wormhole, and is transported into an alternate version of the recent past where she encounters different versions of herself and her friend and lab partner, Bob. Trapped in a world that has diverged from ours during the Cold War, and which prizes collectivism over individuality, Alice is forced to confront her life choices, grappling with profound questions about identity, fate, and the search for meaning.

title: Dead Roommate
overview: Struggling with anxiety and loneliness, college freshman Victor forms an unexpected bond with his new roommate Abbey, who died in the dorm decades earlier. Together, they discover friendship, courage, and the comforting sense of belonging.

title: The Barrel
overview: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

title: PARANOIA
overview: In a series of recent home invasions, a teenage girl must fight her delusive suspicions when she is left home alone.

title: Blue Zone
overview: A team of soldiers are sent to investigate a strange anomaly near enemy lines, only to discover that their mission holds far more dangers than they initially bargained for.

title: Tiger's Rampage
overview: A bachelorette party in the woods becomes a fight for survival when a Bengal tiger escapes the zoo during a storm. Trapped without phone service or escape routes, the women must outwit the predator stalking their cabin.

title: Kashmir 1947
overview: Kashmir 1947 vividly recounts the tumultuous events of 1947–48, drawing on firsthand testimonies, military perspectives, seldom-seen archives, and a captivating narrative. The documentary weaves together music, songs, and potent narration, presenting history in a way that resonates with modern viewers, even those of a younger generation.  "Kashmir 1947" is a documentary that educates, resonates, and stirs the soul. The film transforms history, crafting a compelling narrative that resonates with contemporary audiences.

title: Quantum Jump
overview: In a surreal journey of self-discovery, a man serving twins in a luxurious mansion confronts the unknown world hidden behind the conditioning. He outplays them and embarks on a symbolic odyssey through a magic orchard, the world around him decays into fading echoes of meaning—revealing renewal within the ruins of universal self.

title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

title: Monkey Boy
overview: Frank is a successful comic book author who is struggling to reinvent himself. His series is no longer selling, and his publisher is pushing him to move on. But Frank lives with Monkey Boy, the main character from his series, and he doesn’t know how to let him go.

title: The Space of the Dream
overview: In a post-human world where dreams have vanished, a solitary woman wanders through silent cities, carrying with her memories of love and humanity that endure despite the desolation.

title: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
overview: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.

title: We Will Haunt Your Archive
overview: December 2, 2023. A queer protest erupts in San Francisco in solidarity with Palestine. The film situates this action within the longer history of ACT UP’s activism during the AIDS crisis. It explores glitch as a radical feminist tactic for resisting contemporary regimes of surveillance and silencing.

title: Operation Red Leppard
overview: Canadian military organization, M.U.D., enlists their most skilled operative for a highly dangerous mission.

title: Summer Windows
overview: When an ambitious teenager has different plans for her future then originally planned with her friend, she sets up a backyard concert in an attempt to get everyone together for one last time. She must decide if she will allow personal and technical issues get in the way of creating a memorable night

title: The Last Light
overview: In a world bound by prophecy, the rise of the Dark Lord threatens to plunge everything into eternal darkness. As supernatural forces awaken, three unlikely heroes—Black Hawk, a reluctant warrior tied to a powerful spirit, Kookoo Monkey, a chaotic fighter, and the coward Vesante Elevante—are drawn together as the last hope against an unstoppable fate. But the prophecy is clear: they are destined to fail. Hunted by deadly enemies and facing powers beyond their control, they must fight to survive a war that may already be lost. Blending action, horror, and chaotic humor, The Last Light begins a story where destiny itself is the greatest enemy.

title: Out of Options
overview: Lee Elbaz, a 36-year-old Israeli, was arrested by the FBI, exposing a global fraud industry. While serving 22 years in prison, she maintains her innocence as the industry’s leaders evade punishment.

title: Face Value
overview: Gil Jibli, forensic sketch artist, reconstructs the faces of loved ones erased from the world and reveals how the human gaze transforms damaged memory into an act of love, repair, and healing.

title: A Message
overview: A Message is a short-form documentary draft capturing the raw, unmediated protests and performances of queer Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush while facing pink washing propaganda. Created by trans Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush, this film rejects the flattening narrative of tragedy. Instead, it posits Palestinian Futurism - a framework where those in exile are not merely survivors, but the architects of a liberated cultural and political future.

title: Final Orders
overview: Set in France in 1916, three British soldier's are facing the firing squad for cowardness. As they await their fate they have to overcome their own differences and class as in the eyes of death all men are equal.

title: The Last Wild River
overview: Dr Struzynski spent decades fighting for the survival of noble crayfish. A documentary journey into nature, between fairy tale and reality, reflecting on resilience, dedication, and belief that even one person can change the world.

title: CASE No.
overview: After an "unfortunate incident" at an e-commerce warehouse, Aneta, a young manager, testifies before the committee and takes part in a reconstruction of the events.

title: Blowfish
overview: A drifting young high school dropout gets himself employed at a suburban fish store, where he decides to steal a rare and valuable pufferfish that will help him start his life afresh. In his efforts to sell the precious item to a wealthy collector, the scheme begins to deteriorate into paranoia, dangerous situations, and unhealthy relationships. When faced with the results of his dishonesty, he must confront himself and understand the true consequences of his actions.

title: It Was Just an Accident
overview: After a night of drinking, three privileged college friends accidentally kill a man with their luxury car.

title: Video Hearts
overview: A mysterious VHS dating tape from the 1980s becomes the centerpiece of a chilling found-footage nightmare in Video Hearts, a horror short from filmmaker Ken Cohen. What begins as an awkward relic of lonely-hearts video culture slowly reveals something far more sinister hidden beneath the tape’s nostalgic surface, blending analog horror aesthetics with eerie psychological dread.

title: My Willow
overview: A father and daughter that enjoy spending the night in creepy places get more than what they wanted.

title: Elisa
overview: In a world where dreams intertwine with television fame, a young actress faces profound alienation and the loss of her identity when her iconic character begins to blur the boundaries of her own existence. As boundaries disappear and mirrors reflect a foreign face, she experiences a growing disconnection from herself and the fruit of her labor. As fans and colleagues mistake her for her fictional alter-ego, stripping her of her individuality, she enters an internal struggle to reclaim her essence, challenging the limits between fiction and the reality of her own existence and fighting to take control of her destiny before disappearing completely under the shadow of her character.

title: Half-Baked
overview: Kasia is studying at a prestigious French school for future master chefs, whilst her father, Otar, runs a restaurant in Poland serving Georgian specialities. When the girl is expelled from the elite course, she returns home but does not reveal the cause of her sudden arrival to her father.

title: They Were All Named Anzhelika
overview: In a tacky beauty salon, Anżelika works as a manicurist, dozing off between stations and listening to the stories of her clients. She is trying to return to her law studies when her chaotic daily life is disrupted by an unplanned pregnancy. Amidst other people’s opinions, guinea pigs and conversations with an AI bot, she searches for meaning and her own voice.

title: Chinese Animation: A Century
overview: A major documentary paying tribute to the centenary of Chinese animation, the film presents, for the first time on the big screen, a panoramic view of the tumultuous and remarkable development of Chinese animation over the past century, through detailed historical materials, vivid narratives, and profound reflections. It takes audiences on a journey through time, reliving the childhood memories of several generations, and witnessing the extraordinary path of Chinese animation from its inception to its rise, from exploration to its glory.

title: Frights from the Mills
overview: A mysterious forest somewhere in the Łódź region has for generations inspired fear and curiosity among the inhabitants of nearby villages. They recount the stories they told or heard about ghosts and phenomena that defy rational explanation.

title: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: Stories we are made of
overview: The first of five interview short films with renowned painter Edward Povey during the install of a collection of four paintings at 2 Blackburne Terrace. In the first interview we see the install and dive into our first painting.

title: Autumn 2026
overview: In the latest edition of his poetic series, Wojciech Sobczyk reimagines our ideas and fantasies about this season to create a captivating, sensual, and at times unsettling audiovisual poem. From images of the changing autumn landscape, the animator extracts a universal tale of human nature and man’s place and role in the world.

title: Summer of Smooth Asphalt
overview: The heat is so intense that the electronics are overheating. A short circuit occurs at the travelling funfair. The queues come to a halt, the lights go out, the hubbub ceases; only a few sounds can be heard from the rubbish bin.

title: Almost There or a Weenie
overview: Twenty-year-old Lotar functions on the outer fringes of his own ambitions – he lives with his grandmother, lacks courage, inspiration and self-belief, while reality seems to constantly undermine his self-worth. He seeks refuge in his imagination, where he takes on the persona of a confident rapper.

title: Popcorn
overview: Gosha (nicknamed Kukuruza) comes to the casting to try out for the role of a failed robber. Not the smoothest auditions are mixed with memories of today and the film in which Gosha wants to star. A prostitute, a dead Batman, shooting, a chase, a robbery. Where does reality end and fiction begin? And is there much of a difference between them?

title: Kick Ons
overview: When every attempt to leave a looping backyard party fails, two twenty-somethings must confront the fact that their lives- and friendship- are moving on.

title: Supplies
overview: Some time after the outbreak of a global pandemic that turned humans into mindless, terrifying monsters, two young survivors bound together by a necessary need for survival flee their homes in search of safety.

title: Do you see what i see?
overview: In a world  infiltrated by halucinations, a man refuses to leave a relationship that has already ended and continues living inside it.

title: Paper Heart
overview: Having despaired after the painful death of a close friend, Ayan is set to perform at a farewell gathering, which helps him sort out their relationship and understand what she truly meant to him — a friend or a lover.

title: On Air
overview: When a quiet audio engineering student teams up with a classmate to record a podcast for a school project, he finds himself pulled into a flirtatious battle of wit and vulnerability when the “test interview” becomes all too real.

title: Hate That I Made You Love Me
overview: Short film and music video for the lead single on Ariana Grande’s eighth studio album “Petal”

title: The Understudy
overview: A shy high school student, Sienna, tends to keep to herself and doesn't let anyone in. When she decides to audition for her school play she learns being on her own isn't always a good thing.

title: The Light That Remains
overview: An astronaut, Julian, grieving the recent loss of his wife, is selected by Auron Astronautics for the Aether I mission to test the atmosphere after a devastating coronal mass ejection.

title: Góðufellarnir
overview: In a world where gangster rule, we follow Henry Hill through his rise and fall...

title: Made With Love
overview: Director Max O'Connor Hurni crafts an intimate portrait of his family, tracing its history, exploring how it shaped his identity, and reflecting on his experience growing up with same-sex parents.

title: The NOAH Flood
overview: The Noah Flood investigates the biblical story of Noah through dramatic reenactments, geological evidence, and historical analysis. From massive rock formations to fossil mysteries, the film asks a bold question, could the global flood described in Genesis be real history written in the earth itself?

title: Escape!
overview: Four friends wake up and find themselves trapped in an unfamiliar room, disoriented and without their phones. As confusion gives way to tension, they search for answers, grappling with rising paranoia, fractured memories, and the tickling pressure of a mysterious countdown. With no clear idea of how they go there and no way out, they are forced to confront not only their circumstances but also each other.

title: Doña Quijuca de Las siete Villas
Agatha
overview: A murdered victim of abuse returns to take revenge on humanity, drawn toward a young man whose troubled psyche may draw more similarites to the dead than he first thought.

title: Lesbian Cleaning Service
overview: Between meticulous flower arrangements and sanitising sex toys, they must face the inevitable questions and washes of pain that come with falling in and out of love.

title: Something Romantic
overview: A young couple in Sydney return home from a “very special” night out.

title: Autumn Leaves
overview: On the edge of herself, Ellie retreats into memory, not to escape, but to find a reason to stay. A quiet, unflinching portrait of a young woman fighting to remember who she was before the world got loud.

title: SKIN!
overview: A frantically panicked man attempts to make a meal to impress his friends

title: HOA Heist
overview: Neighbors take on a secret HOA mission.

title: Her Choice
overview: Upon receiving life altering news, a young American woman must confront a dark, restless spirit, keeping her from choosing a path forward.

title: Homage
overview: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

title: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure
overview: An astonishing award-winning documentary that goes beyond asking whether extraterrestrial contact is real - and into the more unsettling question of why, drawing on firsthand accounts and evidence for what intelligent life beyond our world may be.

title: All Night Wrong
overview: Gary and Ell (a married man with an inferiority complex, and a grieving young widow) meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: Wet Paper Bag
overview: A former investigative journalist goes undercover at a psychedelic wellness center to find her missing sister. What she uncovers is far more unsettling than she expected.  Wet Paper Bag is a psychological drama that explores identity, control, and the quiet tension beneath carefully constructed lives.

title: How to Conquer the World
overview: What will be left behind when humanity vanishes from the surface of the earth? Abandoned stations, schools and plants create a post-apocalyptic landscape of the world without people.

title: The Turning
overview: Normal circumstances. Unnatural results.

title: Carla and Her Legs
overview: Carla, who has no legs, is reduced by people around her to a curiosity rather than an artist. She lives for acrobatics, but works as an assistant in a variety show, invisible to the world of stage. When the theater begins to decline, the director offers her the chance to perform.

title: Loud Gun
overview: A Guy Randomly FInds A Gun In Front Of His House, What Will Happen Next?

title: Faculty of Philology
overview: A student film that is a parody of popular para-documentaries broadcast on Polish television. Agnieszka realizes she's failing her film analysis class. To earn money for conditional pass, she commits immoral acts.

title: Three's a Company
overview: Nava, Miki, and Ilan live together while running Tmuna Theater. The film portrays an alternative family that built an alternative theater, navigating between institutional recognition and an ongoing struggle for survival.

title: Black Gold: The Story of Israeli Hip Hop
The Campaign
overview: The Campaign dives into how this is not just a war of rockets and gunfire, but one of narratives: a global effort to shape public perception around Gaza, Israel, the West, and the Jewish people. It’s a war fought through propaganda, disinformation, and emotional manipulation, amplified by both mainstream and social media.

title: A Short Film About War
overview: Fahed, a Palestinian, has been studying film directing in Poland for several years. He is learning the ropes on the set of a production about the Second World War. For the time being, he is working as a sound technician’s assistant, but he soon gets the chance to take on a slightly different role. Although it is an unconventional choice, the young man agrees to play the role of a Nazi.

title: Woodeaters
overview: In a historic Lemko church in the region of Podkarpacie, a quiet, relentless battle is being fought against wood-boring beetles that are destroying the church structure. An entomologist, in an attempt to save the church, resorts to radical measures bearing a historical burden.

title: Procrastination Yoga
overview: The morning begins with a scream - the day ahead promises a barrage of chores, and the pressure to make money leaves no room for relaxation.

title: Mbappé, la diplomatie du ballon rond
High Noon
overview: A lone outlaw finds shelter in a seemingly empty saloon.

title: Learning, Studying… Always Perfecting: The Making of One Battle After Another
overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary filmed during the production of Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another, featuring candid moments from the cast and crew.

title: Christine Bermas: All The Way
overview: Get to know the woman behind the daring roles as Christine Bermas opens up beyond the camera. From her dating style to behind-the-scenes stories and personal experiences in her most talked about films, this special reveals a more honest and intimate side of the actress.

title: Slow & Stupendous
overview: Two friends go on an adventure to find a missing film in the Slow & Stupendous series.

title: PULSE
overview: A man isolated from society appears to have nothing to show for his life, yet in his solitude, he has quietly taught himself to see and hear the world with a depth and beauty that most people are too distracted to ever find.

title: Sundown Syndrome
overview: A homeless eats a strange biscuit and begins to hallucinate; everything around him becomes an evil space.

title: Expert Marksmanship: A Path to Olympic Gold Medal
overview: This 1962 unclassified documentary short features footage of Captain W. W. McMillan's marksmanship skills, and his "Path to Olympic Gold Medal" at the 1960 Olympics.  While depicting Marines caring for rifles and practicing marksmanship at large shooting ranges, the majority of the film focuses on an interview of McMillan, where he provides marksmanship instruction and demonstrates each step, focusing on fundamentals like grip, stance, stability, sighting alignment and trigger control for rapid fire shooting with pistols and revolvers.  The film also features footage of McMillan at the Olympics and multiple creative "trick shots" by McMillan: teacups, poker chips, playing cards, upside down pistol shots and slight aligning with mirrors.

title: FASITO
overview: Experimental short film that follows the journey of some friends through the landscapes of Moreno.

title: Are We Human Yet?
overview: When Logan gets pulled into an AI’s mind, he must avoid being hunted by the android to find a way of escape before he will lose his humanity forever.

title: Let's Make Noise
overview: When the government tries to take away women’s right to vote, Stella joins forces with Carlotta and Marco to raise awareness. In doing so, she meets Prof. Zanetti, once an inspiring woman, now embittered after a life of lost battles.

title: Sol Summer
overview: A woman, healing from her family's wounds, recounts her past to a Deity before the world's coming judgment.

title: Masters of the Universe
overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

title: Peddi
overview: In 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh, a spirited villager unites his community through sports to defend their pride against a powerful rivals.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance
overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

title: Taming The Beast
overview: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

title: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
overview: Examines the legacy, cultural impact, and body of work of American R&B/funk/jazz/soul/disco band Earth, Wind & Fire, and will feature exclusive access to the band’s archives of visual, audio, and written material, as well as the support of the estate of Maurice White and the band.

title: Hungry
overview: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.

title: Wild Sing
overview: "Triangle," a three-member co-ed K-pop group that once dominated the music scene, disbanded overnight after being caught up in an unexpected scandal. Twenty years later, leader Hyunwoo receives an offer to perform on stage as "Triangle" for a chance to make a comeback and sets out to find the other members and seize the opportunity. "Even if war breaks out, we're going on stage today no matter what!" Hyunwoo, who is now a struggling TV personality, Domi, who is married into a rich family, and Sanggu, who is drowning in debt from his solo album releases, somehow reunite and head to the concert hall. But the situation spirals out of control when YGP, the CEO of their former agency with whom they share a bitter history, and Seonggon, the "Prince of Ballad" and former rival of "Triangle," also appear…

title: The Remedy
overview: A troubled young man is the caregiver for both his terminally-ill mother and his mentally-ill sister. When he makes a desperate attempt to save his mom, he unleashes a supernatural entity that feeds on human flesh.

title: Ravel in a Thousand Sparkles
overview: A musical and visual account of the life and exceptional and immortal work of the French composer Maurice Ravel (1875-1937).

title: Anna VS the Kids
overview: Anna, a friendly but reclusive fortysomething, harbors an unusual phobia: she’s terrified of children. When she reconnects with Alexandre, her ex-boyfriend she never stopped loving, she thinks she’s finally found happiness… until she discovers he has two kids. When circumstances force her to care for them alone, a panicked Anna reluctantly agrees. Between ridiculous rules and absurd situations, this forced living arrangement might just change everything… for worse, but also for better.

title: On the Road
overview: Veneno, a rebellious young drifter, frequents roadside diners where he sleeps with truck drivers. Urgently needing a ride, he meets Muñeco, a hard-edged driver who keeps to himself. He convinces Muñeco to take him deep into the hyper-masculine world of long-haul trucking across the north of Mexico. As they travel together and an unexpected intimacy builds between them, shadows from Veneno’s past resurface, putting both their lives at risk.

title: Bouchra
overview: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

title: In-I In Motion
overview: In 2007, Juliette Binoche and Akram Khan took a break and co-created In-I, an original performance that toured the world. Today, Juliette Binoche revisits that exhilarating journey. Through unfamiliar images, she reflects on creation, its challenges, and the personal transformation it brings as a filmmaker.

title: Pilgrims
overview: Children in "The Village" go on a pilgrimage when they come of age. Daisy wonders why some of the pilgrims do not return. Daisy heads to "The Origin", a term used by the village people to refer to Earth, to find the missing pilgrims and discover the secrets of her village.

title: A Thing of the Past
overview: A pharmaceutical trial promises Aya her lost memories, but as they return, her body begins to manifest them in disturbing ways.

title: Impasto
overview: An illustrator in Paris is stuck in his routine and stuck for ideas, until he follows the music he hears from his window into the night...

title: Calling You
overview: After a middle-aged father falls mysteriously into a coma that transports him to an idealised version of his past, his daughter must do all things necessary to rescue him from an eternal trap.

title: Local Lionesses
overview: Documentary about the newly founded Bath City FC women's team and how the recent successes of the England Lionesses is reflecting greatly in the lower level of the women's football pyramid.

title: Test
overview: Eddie dreams of becoming a bodybuilding champion and escaping rural Ohio. Determined to prove himself, he begins training under a renowned coach and dedicates his life to the demanding discipline of the sport. His ambitions, however, create tension at home—particularly with his deeply religious mother, who disapproves of the path he has chosen and the lifestyle surrounding the bodybuilding world. As he pushes his body and mind to the limit in pursuit of success, he must navigate family conflict, personal sacrifice, and the pressure to live up to expectations while chasing his dream.

title: Las Vegas, Cuba
overview: In the future, a traveling android arrives in a deserted Havana in search of Las Vegas, a mythical cabaret founded by a guerrilla fighter.

title: A menina que queria ser pedra
overview: A curious boy and a serene girl meet by the edge of a lake. There, reflections on life emerge in subtle and unexpected ways. After all, what does it mean to be a stone?

title: Aterro Zeitgeist
overview: A story about a strange island and its citizens with concrete heads, and a landfill where they believed they could rid themselves of their troubles—until a small clay carranca appears. A surreal tale about how every action has consequences.

title: Kika Não Foi Convidada
overview: A young girl discovers she is not welcome at a birthday party. As they learn the value of true friendship, children offer a lesson in empathy and inclusion.

title: Nosso Tempero
overview: In a small village in the interior of Rio Grande do Norte, where cashews dominate the landscape, a girl born and raised there confesses that she hates the fruit. A film created as part of a filmmaking workshop from the Projeto Animação (IMA).
directors: Alunos e alunas da Escola Municipal João Victor

title: Cerimônia
overview: When I first moved in with friends, it became a habit to have people over all the time.

title: Pinguim de Doce de Leite
overview: Future memories take shape on an ordinary night in Goiás. In the backyard of his grandmother’s house, Caju, a 10-year-old child, will spend his first sleepless night with the friends of his uncle Tiago, a rebellious young man.

title: Pirexia
overview: Baby, a rising rock star, is tormented by a fever that prevents him from creating new music. When he receives a call from Pepeu, his former musical partner and ex-lover, they decide to compose one last song together — a melody of healing and resurrection to be performed on a night of a blood moon.

title: De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco 2
overview: The sequel to 'De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco'

title: PLAVE Asia Tour [DASH: Quantum Leap] Encore in Cinemas
overview: PLAVE, the group that has now become legendary, brings you an intense performance that only they can deliver. The historic moment when the first virtual idol group entered the Gocheok Sky Dome — the overwhelming energy of [DASH: Quantum Leap] Encore, a night filled with shared emotion, now unfolds on the big screen! From “Dash,” the anthem that signaled the start of a new generation, to the heartfelt fan songs dedicated solely to PLLI, relive the dreamlike moments achieved together in theaters once more.

title: James: Getting Away with It
overview: The first-ever authorised tell-all documentary about iconic British band James.

title: Tickling the Devil
overview: Christopher Morris took part in 28 wars. Armed with a photographic camera, he documented bloody conflicts across the world. Today, he tries to lead a peaceful family life, but the demons of war continue to haunt him, and turbulent American reality calls out to him at every turn.

title: The Last Family Tape
overview: Kuba returns from rehab for Christmas. His parents are surprised by his presence, and his younger brother makes no secret of his hostility. Resentment and grievances persist even as the family members gather for a festive dinner and share the Christmas wafer.

title: Beach Goers
overview: A day at the beach takes a turn for the worst for a small friend group when one of them disappears mysteriously. It’s a mad dash to try and find her as quickly as possible whilst also preparing for the worst.

title: Paralysis
overview: During a terrifying episode of sleep paralysis, Natasha finds herself trapped in a world where time stops, her body betrays her, and a grotesque entity crawls closer, turning her struggle to wake into a desperate fight for spiritual survival.

title: The Bargain
overview: A young girl summons the Devil to get justice from her abusive foster father. The Devil is willing to make a deal but in Ruth’s desire for revenge exceeds her nerve. A chilling tale of revenge, religion and desperation in our lowest moments.

title: The Nest
overview: Wake up, get ready, a quick breakfast to the sound of his favourite jazz – and it is time to rush off to work, just like every day.

title: Birth
overview: A ritual, words from a long-forgotten language. In 2018, an Egyptian mother fights in court for the fundamental rights of her daughter who was born out of wedlock. The film is inspired by this event. With great tenderness and sensitivity, Birth interweaves the story of this struggle with images of an archaic birth ritual.

title: Commissioned Confession
overview: An artist born in Jerusalem is commissioned by a German institution to create a work of art about another artist – a sculptor celebrated by the Nazis. He approaches the task with a silent film. How does one describe something that is, by the very nature of its commission, steeped in violence?

title: Sleeping Beauty
overview: After a long separation, a young soldier and his sister are reunited under the full moon. This fragmentary fable is enough here to open up a cinematic universe in enchantingly composed vignettes: High-contrast chiaroscuro – an artistic technique that uses strong contrasts between light and shadow to create depth, volume and dramatic moods – frames the enigmatic figures.

title: Three Stars
overview: Three star reviews are tricky. Some people think they're good and some think they're bad. So they really can go either way.

title: Three
overview: A young woman makes an interesting discovery while waiting for the subway. Could this completely change her life?

title: Dry & Error
overview: At three o'clock at the gas station.

title: Ashtray
overview: Mr. Herold is being harassed on the phone. He’s being pressured to buy something he has absolutely no use for. However, he has no idea just how skilled the salesperson on the other end of the line is.

title: Pollux
overview: Two scientists make a discovery of unimaginable proportions. But what should they do with it? Pollux moves between dystopia and utopia and presents an ethical dilemma: should one share a world-shattering invention with a society that one does not trust to handle it well?

title: Oz Troikas
overview: Australian animals. In threes. Mostly.

title: Ghosts in the Fog
overview: From the team behind Never Hike Alone, Ghosts in the Fog: an animated Friday the 13th fan film follows three friends – Lana, Dom, and Brandon – who get lost in a mysterious fog while camping near Crystal Lake and mistakenly enter the hunting grounds of Jason Voorhees.

title: Frankie the Rabbit’s Final Preparations
overview: Franio the rabbit has been preparing for a long time for the day that is set to change everything. A lamp, stool and a new rope – every item is already in place.

title: Love, Ngo
overview: “Love, Ngo” follows Ngongo, a hardworking young man who volunteers at a cleft lip and palate foundation while helping at his mother’s burger stand. The film explores his struggles with love, family and self-acceptance after falling for a woman whose family disapproves of his condition and social status.

title: Jhora Bokul
overview: Upcoming Eid UL Adha Natok of Bangladesh 2026

title: The Hadron Collider: In Search of the Peace Particle
overview: In the aftermath of Hiroshima, a group of scientists vowed never to turn knowledge into weapons again, and from that promise, CERN was born.  Deep underground, researchers from nations in conflict have worked side by side for decades, driven by curiosity and shared wonder. For 70 years, CERN has stood as an act of hope, a place where collaboration transcends borders, even as the world above grows more divided.  Blending poetry, music and rare archival footage of Oppenheimer with remarkable access to the Large Hadron Collider, the film explores how science, politics and culture collide.

title: Rabbit Gnaw
overview: After a brief encounter with an enigmatic woman, a voyeuristic illustrator finds himself lost in an endless rabbit hole of uncanny coincidences and forgotten memories, unable to shake the strange feeling that she strikingly resembles a missing woman from his hometown.

title: SOARING
overview: SOARING follows athletes on their climb to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games. Chasing their goals and overcoming challenges, they aren’t trying to prove anything to anyone. But in the process, their pursuit uplifts everyone.

title: Dogwood
overview: A grad student, home for the week and bouncing back from depression, reencounters an old "friend".

title: ARE YOU TELLING ME THAT YOU KNOW WHAT TO DO BECAUSE YOU GET NOTES FROM THE FUTURE TELLING YOU SO?
overview: After finding a note in his locker, a student discovers that he is receiving messages from his future self. As the instructions become increasingly specific, he begins to follow that path that seems to have been laid out for him.

title: Graveyard Shift
overview: A lone office worker is stuck in a perpetual work loop. Once they become aware of that fact they start noticing the flaws in the environment; it causes their mental state to unravel.

title: Game Face
overview: Time is running out, and dude bro Jake needs to print his final essay in order to go to The Game. But, the only way to do that is to use the printer in the Dorothy Center, his campus’s queer safe space. To do so, he goes through a transformation.

title: The LPC Files - Episode 1
overview: A short film following the first installment in the LPC files film franchise. Chris Evans got her pregnant?

title: Tutti Frutti
overview: How are you doing, Céline Sciamma?

title: The Little Dominican House
overview: On March 27, 2026, ten students and two teachers set course for the Dominican Republic. Their mission? To change a family's future.

title: Barako
overview: In his most daring VMX appearance yet, sought-after star Nico Loco explores manhood through a bold, sexy showcase of male-to-male films on VMX.

title: Agora
overview: A chance encounter with an online dating match turns awkward when an unexpected presence reveals their true colours. A comedy on moral masking.

title: The Hot Seat
overview: World Cup winners from France 1998 and France 2018, plus a crew of comedians, face off in a no-holds-barred comedy roast hosted by Paul de Saint Sernin.

title: THE HUM
overview: During his class, Leo, who struggles with ADHD, fights to write a single word while the sensory overload of the room pushes him to his breaking point.

title: Chirag Panjwani: Dr. Panjwani
overview: A stand up comedy special about Chirag's father and his father's bravery.

title: Crush
overview: Solange is a well-ordered wife and mother. She has great admiration for her sister-in-law Juliette, who has just left her husband. Like a fairy godmother, Solange decides to introduce Juliette to a former colleague. Dimitri is handsome and very charismatic. But could Solange be betraying her own desires by offering him to Juliette?

title: Focal Length
overview: Ada, a legal investigator, is assigned to surveil a politician and expose a political conspiracy. As the stakes rise, she must confront a difficult question: will she uncover the truth, or will her own methods and troubled past catch up with her first?

title: Ace and Cody vs. The Fry
overview: In the spirit of Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, Ace and Cody vs. The Fry is a high-energy, hyper-stylized short film that turns the most trivial moment—the last fry in the bucket—into the most important battle of two best friends’ lives. The second that lone fry is spotted, Ace makes the first move, setting off a breathless chase through a sprawling park that transforms the fields into a full-blown war zone. As the pursuit escalates like a video game fight, Ace and Cody are pushed to increasingly ridiculous heights in a showdown where everything seems to hinge on a single french fry.

title: Lemonade
overview: The second "visual album" (a collection of short films) by Beyoncé, this time around she takes a piercing look at racial issues and feminist concepts through a sexualized, satirical, and solemn tone.

title: Sampha: Process
overview: Process is a striking, avant-garde portrait of Sampha using documentary-style footage to depict his roots in Morden, South London, and Freetown, Sierra Leone.

title: Wind
overview: In a time after devastating wars, plagues, and natural disasters, the social order has collapsed, and new moral systems, beliefs, and forms of survival emerge. The story follows Ivan Morozov, who leaves his wife Katya to search for necessities, and meets Sergei Volkov, a mysterious companion. Together, they travel through haunting landscapes filled with forgotten villages, strange rituals, and mythological echoes, culminating in a profound and painful choice.

title: Smart Working
overview: The story follows Giuliano, whose life has improved thanks to his working from home, but his colleagues’ poor performance threatens to force everyone back to the office. Meanwhile, he and his wife, Laura, are expecting a second child and are looking for a bigger home. As Laura makes up her mind about a controversial job offer, Giuliano’s co-workers turn their flat into a makeshift office, rekindling their efficiency and organisation. Amid intrusive co-workers and domestic chaos, Giuliano will have to find creative solutions to save his job, his family and the dream of a new home.

title: The Boy with the Light Blue Eyes
overview: A cursed blue-eyed boy seeks love in a remote mountain ruled by superstition.

title: Sleep No More
overview: Two sisters deal with the sudden death of their mother at a wig factory. One believes it was suicide while the other is certain it was a result of possession and takes a job at the factory to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, their brother - born with an eerie gift to regenerate his own body - catches the attention of a ghostly figure roaming the factory, searching for a vessel to inhabit.

title: Scary Movie
overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

title: Labyrinth of Lost Boys
overview: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

title: BLOOD INCANTATION - All Gates Open: In Search of Absolute Elsewhere
overview: The film tells the story of Blood Incantation’s time in Berlin during the summer of 2023, recording “Absolute Elsewhere” at the legendary Hansa Studios.

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
overview: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

title: Skateboarding Is Not for Girls
overview: When a conservative tradition of bridal sale becomes a solution for a financial family problem, Adela dives into a completely new world where she gets caught between traditional and modern values.

title: She Keeps Me Young
overview: Michelle is floating through life until a surprising connection with a high schooler challenges her friendship with her overbearing best friend, in this bitingly astute and exceptionally hilarious satire.

title: Life in a Beat
overview: Lena is a 20 year old woman who lives in Athens, works at a local supermarket and lives with her family.What if keeping her baby is the only way to keep her job?

title: The Accompanist
overview: Emily accidentally tells her school nurse that her dementia-stricken grandpa almost got them killed, a rookie child-welfare agent is sent to their house to investigate. A botched extraction ensues and Emily is taken and placed with Sylvia, a new foster parent.

title: Prank Night
overview: A young woman seeks revenge on the group of thugs that attacked her family.

title: All That We Never Were
overview: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

title: Cordélicos: A Origem do Cabra da Peste
Mare's Nest
overview: Moon travels through a mysterious unexplained world free of adults. Moon meets a scholar turned sage and her translator in a mountain hut, where she tries to understand what is happening, based on a play by Don DeLillo. She meets many others who perform for her, show her a film, give her gifts, show her different possibilities for living. She observes and moves on into an unknown future.

title: Dolores
overview: On the eve of her 65th birthday, Dolores has a premonition: her life is about to change. She will own a successful casino. However, her gambling addiction of the past may work against her. Deborah, her only daughter, waits for her boyfriend's release from prison to start a new life, whilst her granddaughter Duda clings to a chance of working in the United States. All three women will strive to make their dreams of a better life a reality, going for it all or nothing.

title: Love( ) Mave
overview: The journey of Mavis, a 23 year old writer based in New York, who's longing for love has had a turbulence lately; despite living the "happily ever after" with her long term boyfriend - Rehan. Being the gifted writer that she is, ironically she can't seem to find the words to express the sudden shift of feelings towards her partner. Tackling themes such as guilt, love, and falling out of it; Love ( ) Mave explores what it's like to be in love with someone with all your being, but just not the way as you had before and all the strings of intimacy in between.

title: Nobody Loves Kay
overview: Kay, a high school gamer, loses his best friend to become a pro. After a setback, he rises again and meets his rival in the Mobile Legends world finals.

title: The Wedding Entertainer (The Tale of Moishe Badhan)
overview: Jerusalem's greatest badchan (Hasidic wedding comedian), wrecked his career because of liquor and a big mouth, gets a second chance as the sidekick of the famous American Badchan Meshulam. At the wedding, everything spins out of control.

title: I Understand Your Displeasure
overview: Heike works at a cleaning company, where every day she has to handle her team’s struggles, the pressure of delivering a spotless job, and the need to keep clients and boss happy. When a powerful subcontractor threatens to withdraw his support if she does not provide more work for his team, Heike faces a difficult choice. To comply, she must sacrifice one of her own employees. As the pressure closes in, Heike must decide how far she is willing to go to meet the job’s ruthless demands.

title: Maa Behen
overview: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.

title: Imaginal Disk
overview: This film accompanying concept album 'Imaginal Disk' takes you on the journey of True on the path to becoming the "purest you". What soon unfolds is a cinematic, hypnotically beautiful quest to rediscover the essence of being a human.

title: Dacha
overview: To Be Added soon

title: Mil pedazos
overview: Miguel (55), Isabel (45), and Emilia (9) go on vacation with their dog, Eve. Suddenly, an accident in the middle of the desert leaves the mother seriously injured. Miguel, trying to save Emilia, embarks on a personal journey with his daughter to find answers about what happened. Three months later, Isabel awakens from a coma and begins a personal, loving, and intuitive quest to rebuild her family.

title: A Quiet House
overview: SHE’S ALWAYS BEEN AN OLD SOUL Sian and Lewis, are a married couple spend who their days attempting to reach out to their daughter, Hope. Sian brings meals to their room whilst Lewis waits and listens. However, the couple are stuck in a loop that conceals reality. The evening brings warmth and comfort, whilst the harsh morning light reveals the truth of what lies beyond Hope’s door.

title: Kucing Hitam
overview: Natalie's life turns into a terrifying nightmare after her youngest daughter brings home a mysterious black cat with the power to resurrect the dead. Family members who died in a tragic incident return to life as cold strangers. Natalie is trapped inside the house with a substitute entity controlled by the cat. She soon discovers the harsh reality that her real family is gone and can only watch her from the window as unreachable shadows.

title: La Lucha De Lucia
overview: Lucía “La Guerrera”, a 16-year-old Mexican lucha libre wrestler, as she struggles to find herself in the wrestling world that she grew up in. Her Father, “El Patron Enmascarado”, who has trained her from a young age, believes that she must maintain the tactics of a ruda (a wrestler who plays dirty to win) in order to have a successful wrestling career. A persona that has laid the foundation of their family’s legacy for generations and been the key to their success. Lucía is determined to challenge her family’s ways. She is left to decide if she will trust her own intuition and put up a real fight or play by the unspoken rules of the game, surrendering to the strategy that has been forced upon her.

title: Kata Hati
overview: When celebrity actress Ayra Natasha's glamorous life unravels in one humiliating night - a red carpet disaster, a cheating boyfriend, and a viral disappearance, she finds herself in the back seat of a stranger's car, ugly-crying into a box of tissues. Her unlikely rescuer is Imran Firdaus, an e-hailing driver with nowhere particular to be and no reason to care… except that he does.  What begins as a forced arrangement - Imran hired as Ayra's personal driver to contain a tabloid storm slowly becomes the one real thing in both their lives. But Ayra belongs to a carefully constructed world of sponsors, film contracts, and a power couple narrative that her manager-sister Maya cannot afford to let fall apart.  Kata Hati is a Malay-language romantic comedy about the words we perform for the world, and the ones we only dare say to the ones we love.

title: The Ashes of Love
overview: Two wounded souls meet in Hiroshima, a city that remembers everything, and together they confront the love and pain they've tried to forget.

title: Frampton
overview: Follows a rock icon who lost everything and fought his way back, again and again.

title: Mario
overview: Ronald Reagan’s America sets the stage for Mario Cuomo, the son of Italian immigrants who rose to become Governor of New York and, in his defining 1984 DNC speech, offered a powerful vision of leadership rooted in compassion.

title: Turn It Up!
overview: An indie rock band struggling to make its mark finds a possible meal ticket in an infectious new guitar riff. Unfortunately, it’s also a cursed melody that just so happens to open a portal to another, much scarier dimension.

title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
overview: Seven years after her Grammy Award-winning Amidst the Chaos, Sara Bareilles reunites with her closest collaborators to record a new album. What emerges is an intimate, cinematic process that lays bare the musician's deep connections and inspirations in  Josh Alexander's moving music documentary.

title: Kingston
overview: On the illustrious campus of Kingston College, prestige drips off students, faculty and architecture. Amid social turmoil, three intertwining tales of disillusioned misfits collide under the machinations of an all-seeing institution.

title: Kids Like Me
overview: Explores the life and aspirations of Oliver, a rambunctious and imaginative preteen growing up with disabilities, who’s an avowed murder-mystery aficionado about to craft the perfect mystery caper.

title: TikTok Never Dies
overview: When TikTok faces a nationwide ban, three influencers fight for their livelihoods, their voices, and the First Amendment. As their efforts advance to the Supreme Court, questions swirl around the stakes, power, and control of the future of social media.

title: American Zoo
overview: The Catskill Game Farm was America's first ever private zoo, fostering beloved childhood memories for a generation before falling into disrepair and closing in 2006. Amongst the rubble, filmmakers discover reels of home movies which would expose a shocking new chapter of the zoo's history.

title: Retrieval
overview: If science allowed you to hold onto a piece of someone you lost, would you? When Christina’s fiancé dies suddenly, she faces the unexpected decision of whether or not to carry on his legacy via postmortem sperm retrieval.

title: Matininó
overview: A multi-generational family of outspoken Puerto Rican women takes center stage as they conceive and perform fantastical film vignettes as a way to navigate painful pasts in this visually-arresting, kaleidoscopic documentary.

title: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
overview: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

title: Top Hat - The Musical
overview: Based on the classic 1935 RKO movie starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, Top Hat is a sparkling romantic cocktail laced with witty comedy, stunning choreography and tap-dancing brilliance, brought to life on stage with lavish sets and gorgeous costumes. Irving Berlin’s irresistible score includes some of Hollywood’s greatest songs, including the immortal Cheek to Cheek, Let’s Face the Music and Dance, Top Hat White Tie and Tails and Puttin’ on the Ritz.  When Broadway star Jerry Travers arrives in London to open a new show, he crosses paths with model Dale Tremont whose beauty sleep is rudely interrupted by Jerry tap dancing in the hotel suite above hers. Instantly smitten, Jerry vows to abandon his bachelor life to win her – but the path of true love never does run smooth.  Put on your top hat, brush off your tails and let this joyous romantic musical comedy sweep you off your feet!

title: Kaya
overview: An outsider in her own culture, half-Filipina Nia secretly trains with queer outcast Malic to join a popular Filipino Martial Arts team in Manila, only to discover that winning starts with accepting who you truly are.

title: Дени и Мэни. В кино!
overview: When Deni, a Labrador, lands a major advertising contract and moves in with his agent, Andrey, he and his cat friend, Manny, who are used to being together, find themselves separated for the first time. Immersed in the dazzling world of show business, Deni gradually realizes that no amount of success can replace family, and that sincerity is more valuable than any contract. Meanwhile, Andrey is going through a crisis in his relationship with his fiancée, and it is Deni who helps him rediscover his faith in love.

title: De Grote Mensen Stad
overview: A young man walks through the city he once looked up to. As everyone around him seems to move with purpose, he wonders if becoming an adult means keeping up or simply finding your own pace.

title: Trapeze
overview: A powerful exploration of autonomy, ancestral ties and Deaf identity expressed through movement, narration and Auslan choreography. A deeply personal work from Jeremy Lowrenčev.

title: All Our Yesterdays
overview: A Viennese actor has a stressful time on a student film set in Belfast.

title: INNER
overview: A writer becomes trapped in a shifting reality where space mirrors his inner world, forcing him to confront a version of himself he no longer recognizes.

title: Mama'ku – Van Jakarta tot de Molukken
overview: Mama’ku: During a trip to Indonesia, dancer Cheroney Pelupessy and her taciturn mother find a way together to come to terms with the mother’s repressed past, marked by migration, domestic violence, and intergenerational trauma. The new documentary by Sven Peetoom (Tussen Wal en Schip – Geruisloos Indisch).

title: Petey & I
overview: Albert Minogue is a grieving father looking for spiritual reconciliation, instead he discovers a baby alien called Petey who he believes to be a reincarnation of his deceased son.

title: 5 Bomoh
overview: Rashdan is a businessman who provides diving services. He has a wife, Sakinah and a daughter, Nisa. Rashdan has been a believer in the superstitious practices and superstitions of his ancestors since childhood, while Sakinah, a medical graduate, believes more in science and believes that as a Muslim, prayer is a powerful weapon in requesting anything he wants. When Nisa did not get 'straight A's in her SPM triak exam, Rashdan panicked because he really wanted his daughter to be the first in her family to study abroad. On the advice of his assistant, Alam, Rashdan forced Sakinah and Nisa to travel all over the country looking for the best amulets so that her daughter's SPM results would be excellent. Every shaman/dukun they met turned out to be a "scammer" shaman who actually only wanted to deceive them and not help Nisa's decision.

title: Queer Blue Sky
overview: After realizing many of the best parts of their relationship were maybe kind of queer, Beth and Chris decide to break up in a queer way too.

title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

title: Poldi
overview: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

title: Космическая Машка
overview: Masha spent her entire 11 years of life with her cosmonaut father at the spaceport. She knows how to fly a plane, a boat, and take responsibility for herself, but she doesn't know how her peers live. To make friends and get used to life on Earth, she goes to a regular school in St. Petersburg, where her incredible adventures begin.

title: Klaasist välikäimla
overview: The members of an untalented amateur band must reunite a year after one of the band members went down the toilet.

title: Maps
overview: Julia and Sérgio set out in search of Rebeca, a missing cycling activist, moving through Brasília, a city marked by silence and unresolved histories. Their investigation leads them to forgotten tragedies, where ruins, memories, and unsettling presences begin to intertwine. Blurring the line between the real and the fantastic, Mapas unfolds as a journey through ghosts of the past that continue to echo in the present.

title: Dream High: Show Musical on Stage
Novak’s case
overview: Frether Warmak, a private investigator with thirty years of experience, is called to the scene of an apparent homicide: a dog-sitter has been found dead in her home, the front door wide open and every dog she was caring for gone without a trace. Accompanied by his young partner Lucas Mancini, he begins interviewing witnesses — none of whom turn out to be particularly reliable. With no solid leads, Frether reluctantly steps away from the case, until a chance encounter on the street puts him face to face with a crucial, unexpected clue.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

title: Hellas 3.0
overview: Three stories. Three directorial perspectives. A cinematic triptych that navigates between humor, absurdity, and Greek reality. Three different filmmakers join forces in a cinematic triptych that observes contemporary Greek reality through humor, absurdity, and a satirical lens.

title: Torn Sky
overview: Belgium in 2021. A tempest and a flood are threatening a small town which has to be evacuated. In the middle of the chaos and the many individual destinies, a little girl disappears and a train is racing towards its ostensible doom.

title: Security
overview: A radio, a table tennis paddle, the drawing of a child – from a respectful distance, the camera captures the few personal belongings of prisoners. The gaze lingers for a long time on everyday objects that are by no means a given in prison and which, through this focus, become defiant symbols of individuality. Intercut images reveal the stark geometry and functionality of the cells, which remain deserted until the very last shot of the film.

title: DAY THREE
overview: Nathan, 23, descends into a night of intimacy, euphoria and disorientation. He jolts awake at the care of paternal figure, Sam, who helps him survive through the aftermath of a chillout. Cracks begin to show as Nathan’s smile is quieter now – aware that survival isn’t the same as safety, and that next time, the night might not let them go so easily.

title: dashed in here, seeing you green
overview: Disappearing acts, or a longing for green. Based on an extract from Virginia Woolf's The Waves.  Part of the "vaster than empires and more slow" cycle, filmic meditations on the fear, fragility, and stupor encountered in mineral, plant, and animal (including the filmmaker) interactions.

title: The Barbershop
overview: As a young foster child searches for belonging in a black barbershop in Copenhagen, he finds himself struggling to be black enough in a place that should feel like home.

title: Fault
overview: An elite tennis star’s reunion with her estranged sister explodes into a battle over buried trauma, threatening her career and her sanity on the eve of the U.S. Open.

title: Fin People
overview: The city is slowly disappearing beneath the water of unknown origin. Some flee, while others adapt to the new reality – because of spending long periods in the water, they grow fins.

title: Slingshot
overview: After scratching his family’s car, a teenage boy experiencing violent growing pains must find a way to stop breaking things as his strained relationship with his Mom comes to a head.

title: The Intervention
overview: A woman rushing home to meet a date is blindsided by an unexpected intervention from friends and family, only to discover her bewildered Hinge match has also been roped into it too.

title: Hindsight
overview: A socially anxious teen faces his ultimate boss battle: buying a video game. His overactive imagination turns a simple transaction into an epic disaster, proving that the real enemy is just awkward small talk.

title: PAPER ANGELS
overview: Mikey Mendoza rises through pro skateboarding and sustainable fashion design to carve out his new identity, despite capitalist and societal forces, leaving his tumultuous childhood in the dust.

title: The Sacrifice
overview: In a brutal dystopian society, a new life can only be created by sacrificing another. In the final hours before the birth, Lucas must secure his child's future - but does he have what it takes?

title: The Abominable Professor Fausto and the Death of Flavio the Unicorn
overview: A film teacher, fed up with his students, decides to start torturing and killing his class in gruesome ways. One student will manage to scape and cross to a parallel universe where she'll encounter a series of misterious creatures who will task her with finding the heart of Flavio the Unicorn in order to save her classmates.

title: Promise Versus Action: Bridging the Gap Till the Coast is Clear
overview: Join George and Matt as they explore the issues faced on the UK coastline and collaborate with Till The Coast Is Clear to raise awareness for plastic pollution.

title: Bubble and Squeak
overview: A depressed hitman conjures an imaginary puppet partner to keep him positive, turning a kill mission into a rescue mission.

title: Are You Afraid of the '90s?
overview: Are You Afraid of the '90s? Is Rob Anderson's debut self-produced special that digs into what '90s TV shows and movies tried to teach us in the '90s about age gaps, teenage pregnancy, underage drinking, racism, LGBTQ+ and more. Shows, movies, and books include Boy Meets World, Walker Texas Ranger, Beverly Hills 90210, Captain Planet and the Planeteers, The Magic School Bus, Blank Check, Dawson's Creek, Baywatch, 7th Heaven, Jack, My Girl, Touched by an Angel, Northern Exposure, Buffy The Vampire Slayer, Ally McBeal, The Rainbow Fish,  and The Berenstain Bears.

title: Bon Cop, Bad Cop: Family Stories
overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary that chronicles the making of the Crave television series. It explores the casting challenges, Indigenous representation, and the creative process of adapting the cult film franchise into a multi-lingual, 6-episode series.

title: Upstream
overview: A young man tries to figure out what lurks in the forest near his home.

title: darker
overview: With darker, Bill Morrison takes inspiration from David Lang’s restrained and highly detailed score to create what he describes as a slowly lilting depiction of the sublime, in which actors, dancers, and acrobats reappear and disappear back into a bubbling morass of time. Morrison’s films often incorporate imagery from decomposing nitrate films, creating a haunting photochemical effect.

title: Momacu
overview: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

title: Grindr Presents: Madonna LIVE in New York
overview: Madonna is performing LIVE! Starting off Pride Month by welcoming the community back to the dance floor, and debuting new tracks from Confessions II.  Motha is delivering, and we’re only four days into Pride. Grab your friends, turn up the volume, and join us for a night of music, celebration, and pure queer joy. The dance floor is officially open!

title: Minnesota Mao
overview: A cutting look at the strange connections between Governor Tim Walz—aka "Minnesota Mao"—and Chairman Mao Zedong, the former dictator of the Chinese Communist Party, based on interviews, archival footage, and news and social media.

title: JON BELLION - LIVE FROM FOREST HILLS STADIUM
overview: The full recording of 2 sold-out nights at Forest Hills Stadium in August 2025.

title: Nike - Rip the Script
overview: Everything in a Hollywood studio was running strictly according to a meticulously crafted commercial script—until the unstoppable instincts of world-class footballers took over. Completely tearing up the director's playbook and shattering the rules of the set, elite athletes and internet culture icons stage a chaotic takeover. A high-octane, unpredictable visual feast celebrating the raw, rebellious, and untamable spirit of the beautiful game.

title: Left Behind
overview: A deaf man searches for understanding.

title: Clear conscience
overview: An extremely honest forest ranger fights for the trust to the very end.

title: Filterkoffie
overview: Nervous job applicant Martijn is offered a magical coffee by HR Manager Rianne, making it impossible for him to lie and causing the interview to take some surprising turns.

title: Aphélie
overview: After running away from a ritual, a child discovers true liberty in the desert.

title: Runner
overview: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time

title: hi, Papa
overview: A daughter revisits past "hello's" in order to learn how to say goodbye to her recently deceased father.

title: The Portrait of Anxiety
overview: Best friends Keng and New embark on a quest to find hornbills. Despite enduring a long and arduous journey, they fail to see even one. What they do find instead is something far more unsettling—something truly chilling.

title: Busaw
overview: In the aftermath of a serial killer's capture, a man searches for what remains of his sister.

title: Signal One
overview: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

title: The Leader
overview: In 1997, thirty-nine members of the American cult known as "Heaven's Gate" committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on American soil. This is their story.

title: Jean-Michel
overview: Follows Basquiat’s early life as the child of middle-class Haitian and Puerto Rican parents in Brooklyn, through his adventures in the punk subculture and up to his breakout as a major American artist. All the while, special attention is paid to Basquiat’s mental and emotional state, with interviews from former friends and colleagues to supplement his sisters’ impressions.

title: Savage House
overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.

title: Mollywood Times
overview: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

title: The Voices of Our Mother
overview: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

title: Micronations
overview: Sovereignty, borders, and community. Passports, constitutions, and anthems. All these topics swirl together in this feature film exploration of micronations. You might just be ready to start your own country by the end of it.

title: The Marked Woman
overview: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

title: The Passenger
overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

title: Madfabulous
overview: When the flamboyant Henry Paget arrives in 1890s North Wales to claim his aristocratic inheritance, his theatrical flair and defiant eccentricities send shockwaves through the upper-class elite, much to the amusement of the local townspeople. Alongside his spirited cousin, Lily, and loyal butler, Gelert, Henry tries to carve out his own identity as the Fifth Marquess, navigating suffocating traditions, scheming relatives, and the long shadow cast by his estranged father.

title: Bandar
overview: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

title: Carolina Caroline
overview: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

title: The Lonely Musketeer
overview: A unique closed-room thriller about greed, revenge and the tragedy of human trauma. Rupert wakes up in a locked room without any doors or windows. He has no clue how he got there, and all he has is his mobile phone. As he investigates, he is haunted by the past and slowly discovers the horror he has gotten into.

title: My Heaven, Your Hell
overview: Over the years, Adela and Victoria live an impossible love story and are strongly punished by the law and by the society of the 60's and 70's in Spain. However, despite all the impediments, they cannot forget each other.

title: Office Romance
overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

title: The Witch Pricker And The Hare
overview: During Scotland’s witch trials in the 17th century, an infamous witch pricker struggles to execute a particularly clever witch when their true identity is at risk of being exposed.

title: Next Life
overview: Ivy finds herself confronted with parallel universes in which her life unspools in very different ways set against the modern London jazz scene.

title: Gugu's World
overview: Gugu, a black boy living with his grandmother, experiences memories and revelations when the old city where she lived returns.

title: The Revisionist
overview: Elise, a successful novelist, does what so many writers do: she manipulates and transforms the people in her life into the characters she needs for her story. As she blurs the line between fiction and reality, her world descends into secrets, lies, and outright betrayal.

title: Cotton Fever
overview: A mosaic of characters struggle with addiction and love on the streets of Boston during the height of the fentanyl epidemic

title: She's the He!
overview: Before graduation, Ethan and Alex pose as trans women in a last ditch effort to quell gay rumors. It's all a joke until Ethan realizes: she really is trans. The two must reckon with their changing friendship, coming out, and coming-of-age.

title: A Sucker's Born Every Minute
overview: Toni, once a famous singer, now has gambling debts and struggles to make ends meet. His luck changes when Malena, a former lover, introduces him to Junior, a wealthy young man, ready to hire him to steal a priceless painting from his own mother. To carry out this supposedly easy heist, Toni recruits a clumsy crew, forming a team in which each one pursues their own interests.

title: The Light We Left Behind
overview: Unai and Elena, childhood friends, skip school to fulfill a forgotten promise: to light fireworks together that they never got around to using. On a tram to a distant beach, long-forgotten memories and feelings resurface. What begins as an escape becomes a journey into who they once were and who they still are.

title: Fujiko
overview: Subjected to harsh treatment by her husband Jiro’s family, Fujiko is devastated when Mari is kidnapped by Jiro’s relatives. With the help of her own mother, Chiyo, Fujiko regains her child. Against the advice and judgment of those around her, she chooses to raise Mari as a single mother.

title: 25 Miles to Normal
overview: Follows a doctor as he reunites with his estranged father and the rest of their family.

title: Twisted Retreat
overview: Four friends on a weekend retreat unravel secrets, sparking tension and betrayal. A game of Truth or Dare turns sinister as an unseen killer stalks them. Paranoia rises, trust shatters, and one by one, they fall—until a shocking truth changes everything.

title: Shake, Rattle & Roll Evil Origins
overview: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.

title: A Scary Movie
overview: During the summer holidays, a documentary-maker and his 12 year-old son stay at an abandoned hotel in Lisbon: an empty hotel like the one in the film The Shining.

title: Part of the System
overview: An experimental synthetic-documentary staged as a one-sided dialogue between c̴r̶e̴a̶t̴i̶v̷e̸ ̸w̴o̷r̴k̵e̷r̷s̸ and the system replacing them. The film questions authorship, consent, and the cost of convenience in times when tools begin to argue for themselves.

title: Happy Hours, Part 1
overview: Two people navigate their relationship within the challenges of careers and family responsibilities and the pursuit of love, despite life’s inevitable obstacles. A character-driven dramedy that explores the emotional journey of young loves who reconnect as adults, with the connective thread of shared joys, loss, and hope. Part one of a trilogy.

title: Via Negativa
overview: Dan, a young priest who has abandoned his conservative diocese after learning of the death of his estranged friend, Paul. Struggling with a deep crisis of faith, he embarks on a journey to find the older priest who once abused Paul during their time in seminary. With a wounded coyote in the back of his car, Dan drifts through the American landscape, encountering eccentric travelers, stealing a gun and other assorted trophies, singing Prince songs and stopping at roadside attractions.

title: Magenta House
overview: Many would tell you that Magenta House is the pinnacle of progression: wonder drug medications, humane living conditions and frequent, compassionate therapy sessions... but something darker exists beneath the surface. When five patients escape from the experimental health facility, all will take wildly different approaches to their brief reintroduction to society. But one thing is for certain - The cats out the bag now, and nothing will ever be the same...

title: Be with You
overview: A high school dropout and delinquent, Jie, falls in love with a quiet, speech-impaired high school girl, Guang, leading to a story of mutual growth and healing.

title: Turncoat
